scope: Selected model and frozen prompt C, all 76 requests through the production HTTP endpoint; no historical probe responses included.

transport.timing: Client wall-clock duration of each request, including HTTP and parsing; model download and bootstrap are excluded

comparison.description: Exact source and complete valid filter; AI OR/AND order and identical AND duplicates are ignored, names are case-insensitive, and same-field gte N AND lte N equals eq N. Other operators, constraints, sort and limit remain exact.

limitations: The 52 main/holdout queries were used for instruction tuning. Their scores are development results, not an independent estimate of generalization.
